title: Many Kinds of Evidence, One History

scenes.tts: Rocks in Pakistan and Egypt hold fossil whales with leg bones. Living whales still carry small hip bones inside their bodies. How can rocks and bones show that whales are related to animals that walked?
scenes.visual: A rock stack with a leg-bone fossil, a living-whale outline with a small hip-bone block, and question marks joining both to a land-mammal box.
scenes.narration: Rocks in Pakistan and Egypt hold fossil whales with leg bones. Living whales still carry small hip bones inside their bodies. How can rocks and bones show that whales are related to animals that walked?

scenes.tts: Start with rocks. A fossil is the preserved remains or traces of a living thing from the past. Sedimentary rock builds up in layers. In an undisturbed stack, the bottom layer came first. So a fossil in a lower layer is older. This is relative dating. It gives an order, not an age in years.
scenes.visual: Layers build from the bottom up, each with a fossil; an arrow marks older to younger.
scenes.narration: Start with rocks. A fossil is the preserved remains or traces of a living thing from the past. Sedimentary rock builds up in layers. In an undisturbed stack, the bottom layer came first. So a fossil in a lower layer is older. This is relative dating. It gives an order, not an age in years.

scenes.tts: Radioactive dating gives ages in years. Certain minerals hold radioactive atoms. These atoms change into other atoms at a steady rate. Measuring the starting atom left, and the product built up, gives the time since the mineral formed. Sometimes, volcanic layers above and below a fossil give two dates. The fossil's age falls between them.
scenes.visual: A bar of starting atom turns into product; then a fossil layer between two dated volcanic layers is bracketed.
scenes.narration: Radioactive dating gives ages in years. Certain minerals hold radioactive atoms. These atoms change into other atoms at a steady rate. Measuring the starting atom left, and the product built up, gives the time since the mineral formed. Sometimes, volcanic layers above and below a fossil give two dates. The fossil's age falls between them.

scenes.tts: DNA gives a second kind of evidence. When DNA is copied, small changes sometimes happen, and some are passed on. Two species that split from a common ancestor recently have had less time to collect differences. So, for matching stretches of DNA, more similar sequences usually mean a more recent common ancestor.
scenes.visual: A row of DNA blocks is copied and one block changes; two made-up cases show a recent split with few differences and an older split with more.
scenes.narration: DNA gives a second kind of evidence. When DNA is copied, small changes sometimes happen, and some are passed on. Two species that split from a common ancestor recently have had less time to collect differences. So, for matching stretches of DNA, more similar sequences usually mean a more recent common ancestor.

scenes.tts: Now put the evidence side by side. Legged whale fossils lie in layers tens of millions of years old. A vestigial structure is a reduced body part that has lost all or most of the job it did in ancestors. Living whales have small hip bones. Vestigial does not mean useless: in males, these bones anchor muscles used in mating. Pantropical spotted dolphin embryos grow hind-limb buds that break down around the fifth week. DNA insertions at the same spots group whales with hippos. They share a common ancestor.
scenes.visual: Four panels fill in one by one: fossils, hip bones, embryo buds, DNA insertions.
scenes.narration: Now put the evidence side by side. Legged whale fossils lie in layers tens of millions of years old. A vestigial structure is a reduced body part that has lost all or most of the job it did in ancestors. Living whales have small hip bones. Vestigial does not mean useless: in males, these bones anchor muscles used in mating. Pantropical spotted dolphin embryos grow hind-limb buds that break down around the fifth week. DNA insertions at the same spots group whales with hippos. They share a common ancestor.

scenes.tts: Each field could have contradicted the others. For whales, they agree. Fossils, anatomy, embryos and DNA are independent kinds of evidence. They point to one history of common descent. This is why the theory of evolution is a well-tested explanation. Whales descend from ancestors that walked on land.
